goldensOwner: mobile-engineer (generates and commits the goldens in c12)
rule: A Flutter golden becomes part of the VS-3 oracle only after design-lead approves it side by side with the prototype baseline of the same state, theme and phone viewport (375). Unapproved goldens make VS-3 BLOCKED, not PASS. `flutter test --update-goldens` output is never self-approving.

comparisonSource.states: Every in-scope state of docs/design/screen-inventory/route-inventory.json that c12 renders in a phone layout; c12 lists any state it does not render and why.

approvalRecord.requestedFrom: mobile-engineer (owned path); bdd-quality reads it at c13

entryShape.golden: repo-relative path of the golden PNG
entryShape.goldenSha256: sha256 of the approved golden bytes
entryShape.tokensSha256: sha256 of docs/design/tokens.json at approval time
entryShape.notes: differences accepted and why (Flutter vs web rendering only; never token, spacing or layout differences)

invalidation: An approval is void when the golden digest, the prototype baseline digest or docs/design/tokens.json digest changes; the golden must be re-approved.
negativeControl: Contract VS-3: running the golden suite with stock ThemeData.dark() must FAIL; additionally a golden whose sha256 is absent from approvals.json must make the provenance check fail.
goldenHarnessRequest: mobile-engineer: the golden suite honours --dart-define=KM_GOLDEN_THEME_OVERRIDE=stock-dark by building the app with ThemeData.dark() instead of the generated themes (VS-3 negative control). If the define is ignored the control passes the goldens and therefore FAILS, so it cannot pass silently.
